thread:
Anika Shah: Pushing this here — PolarisHealth escalated an issue after our 11:03 canary. They report a clear drop in grounding and missing citations for their search+summarize flow. Ticket PH-842 attached.

Anika Shah: Customer examples pasted below (redacted):
> User: 'What are the recommended follow-ups for patient X?'
> Response (post-rollout): long vague paragraph w/o source links.
> Response (pre-rollout screenshot they provided): bullet list with 3 citations and quotes.

Samir Patel: Thanks — do we have the canary release id / deploy tag? Ops bot triggered a deploy at 2026-08-11T11:03Z with tag rwr-2.4.0-canary.

ops-bot: Deploy rwr-2.4.0-canary started by ci-pipeline (build 1228).

Leo Nguyen: Quick hypothesis: the reranker scoring threshold was relaxed in 2.4.0 to prioritize recency; could reduce recall for longer-tail docs. Also we changed embedding dim quantization in the index build for space savings.

Maya Rivera: Customer says the difference is consistent across multiple queries not just one-off. They've tried clearing session state and replaying same user query — still less citations.

Samir Patel: Can you paste the exact request payload they sent? Need to reproduce locally (headers, model ids, route).

Anika Shah: Pasting sanitized payload:
```json
{
  "client_id": "polaris-health-prod",
  "query": "follow-up steps for condition X",
  "pipeline": ["retriever:v3-index-2026-08-10","reranker:rr-1.9"],
  "max_sources": 5
}
```

Anika Shah: And example response (post-rollout):
```json
{
  "answer": "Refer to patient guidelines and monitor symptoms...",
  "sources": []
}
```

Samir Patel: Oof — empty sources list is the smoking gun. Check retriever logs for hits vs score threshold and reranker outputs. Leo — can you check the reranker model weights/threshold config change in the canary?

Leo Nguyen: On it. Early signal: reranker logging shows many candidates but reranker score distribution shifted ~-0.12 on average vs baseline. Might be a model drift from the new quantization kernel. I need the exact index snapshot used by Polaris.

Maya Rivera: Polaris is on region eu-west and pinned to dedicated-pool eu-pool-2. They said traffic was routed to canary despite pin — looks like our canary rollout policy allowed a subset of dedicated boxes to take canary; requesting confirmation from infra.

ops-bot: Routing change: canary overlays applied to 10% of dedicated-pool instances in eu-west at 11:03Z.

Samir Patel: Action items: replicate customer environment in staging (eu-west, pool-2), run the same payload against stable vs canary pipelines, capture retriever hits and reranker scores, and compare source counts. If the reranker is the culprit, propose immediate mitigation: route override for Polaris to stable reranker or increase reranker score floor.

Anika Shah: I've asked Polaris for a few more examples and given temporary routing instructions: we'll pin their org to stable pipeline while we investigate. They're receptive but want an ETA.

Leo Nguyen: Repro plan started. Preliminary staging run: stable returns 3 sources, canary returns 0 for same query. Stack traces show differences in the reranker forward pass due to the quantized kernel path — logits lower.

Samir Patel: Can we roll back the quantized kernel change for reranker in canary and push a hotfix? Or is toggle available in runtime to force float path?

Leo Nguyen: There's a runtime flag to prefer FP32 kernels per model id; I can toggle for the canary nodes. Doing that now in staging to validate.

Maya Rivera: FYI I'm coordinating with infra to route Polaris off canary immediately if we confirm.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-1193 "PolarisHealth grounding regression during canary" — assigned to eng-ml and eng-platform.

Anika Shah: Customer wants daily updates. Proposed timeline: 1) replicate & confirm (4 hrs), 2) mitigation (route override or toggle) (<=8 hrs), 3) full rollback or patched canary (24-48 hrs).

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Please paste staging logs and diff of reranker score distributions once available. Also include any index changes from 2026-08-10 index build.

Leo Nguyen: Uploaded staging comparison: stable: avg reranker score 0.42 (sd 0.11), canary: avg 0.29 (sd 0.14). After forcing FP32 kernel in canary, avg jumped to 0.41 and sources returned. Looks like the quant path was degrading scores.

Maya Rivera: Infra confirmed: we routed Polaris back to stable manually at 13:45Z. Customer reports immediate improvement and provided a "before/after" confirmation.

Anika Shah: Closing loop with Polaris and asked if they'd prefer notification before future canary exposures. They requested opt-out for canary.

Samir Patel: Next steps for us: revert quantized kernel change for reranker in the upcoming deploy, add a canary metric for "sources_returned_count" and a regression alert, and add a per-org canary opt-out flag.

Anika Shah: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket and send daily status to Polaris until fully resolved. :white_check_mark:
